title: Restriction under dependence on initial variables
statement: Let $m\\le n$, let $p$ be an assignment to $n$ variables, and let $C$ be a circuit on $n$ variables whose evaluation on every assignment $x$ equals $f$ applied to the restriction of $x$ to its first $m$ variables. Then, for every assignment $y$ to those $m$ variables, the circuit obtained by restricting $C$ to the first $m$ variables and using $p$ for the remaining variables evaluates to $f(y)$.
hypotheses_covered: Natural numbers m and n with m ≤ n
Padding assignment p on n variables
Function f from assignments on m variables to Boolean values
For every assignment x on n variables, C evaluates to f on the first m coordinates of x
